Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: one finished vertical 9:16 mobile game advertising storyboard keyframe, single panel, high resolution.
Primary request: keyframe for the approved 36-second "ONE TILE LEFT" ad for the existing game Blend Trails: Color Puzzle.
Input images: Image 1 is the actual current gameplay screenshot and is the binding reference for UI, grid, tile size, thick navy outlines, cream board panel and bright cyan sky with pale clouds. Image 2 is the existing white cartoon glove pointer and is the binding reference for the hand. Recreate this exact hand style; use one clean hand, one extended index finger and folded other fingers. These are reference images, not an instruction to copy all screenshot text.
Style: crisp flat 2D toon mobile game, rounded geometric forms, navy #101F54 outlines, cream #FFF5D6 panels, bright cyan sky, red #FF3D47 and blue #0069FF strokes, violet #9224FF only on designated mixed tiles, pale tinted tile fills. Polished authentic gameplay, no photorealism.
Composition: full bleed vertical 9:16 frame, no phone device, no surrounding mockup, one screen only. Large headline in top 15%, one centered rectangular board occupying roughly y=28% to 70%, exactly FIVE COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS of rounded square tiles, twenty tiles total. Keep all outer tiles visible. Below board a small red circle + blue circle = purple circle pill, then compact reset controls with ALL, blue circular arrow, red circular arrow. Headline uses bold playful white letters and thick navy outline.
The human-readable route coordinates below are 1-based ROW,COLUMN, top left (1,1). Paths connect cell centers only with horizontal and vertical segments, no diagonal lines, following every intermediate cell. No invented cell counts, no maze walls, no extra colors, no emoji hands. All text must be legible and exactly as specified. No captions, timecodes, panel labels, watermarks, app store badges or unrelated copy inside image.
PUZZLE A: actual Stage 3, exactly 5 columns x 4 rows.
Red start dot: r1c5. Blue start dot: r4c1.
Colored condition borders: r1c3 red, r4c3 blue, r2c3 violet, r3c3 violet. All other borders navy.
Full red route: r1c5 -> r4c5 -> r4c4 -> r1c4 -> r1c3 -> r3c3.
Full blue route: r4c1 -> r1c1 -> r1c2 -> r4c2 -> r4c3 -> r2c3.
Complete final tile fills, row by row: [blue,blue,red,red,red]; [blue,blue,violet,red,red]; [blue,blue,violet,red,red]; [blue,blue,blue,red,red].
Retain smooth bold colored lines over pale tile fills, like the reference.
SCENE 1, approximately second 2: opening red swipe in progress.
Headline EXACTLY: "SO SATISFYING!"
Red has just traveled from r1c5 down the fifth column to r4c5, then left to r4c4. Only r1c5,r2c5,r3c5,r4c5,r4c4 are red-tinted. The other fifteen tiles are white, retaining the colored condition borders and blue start dot. Blue line has not yet been drawn.
Place the white glove at lower-right of board with its index fingertip exactly touching center r4c4; the hand extends down out of the board, its palm is below it. Show a tight white contact ring under the fingertip, a small leftward motion arrow along the last one-cell red movement, and two subtle translucent trailing finger silhouettes only behind it. This unmistakably communicates a leftward SWIPE, not a stationary tap. Keep hand narrow enough not to hide more than one tile. Energetic clear satisfying first frame.
